indicator_name: National Fund investment income for the year, total (management result plus exchange-rate difference), Minfin report
description: Инвестиционный доход Национального фонда за год, всего (результат управления плюс курсовая разница), по отчёту Минфина
methodology: Million KZT (source: thousand KZT), National Fund of the Republic of Kazakhstan, investment income, total (item 4 of the report): the result of management in tenge plus the exchange-rate difference on recalculation, for the calendar year. Item 4 «Investment income, TOTAL» of the Minfin report as of 1 January of the next year (and of the approved annual reports): the NBK's full-year result. Printed from the year 2022 on; the earlier reports carry only the investment income booked into receipts (NF_INVESTMENT_INCOME_YTD), a different and lagged measure. Every report that prints the item passes total = management result + exchange-rate difference.
